descriptions: The {LOCATION} fades. The {THREAT} recedes. You stand at the edge of the world — and it was enough.

commands.look: There is nothing left to look at. The story is over.

latents.fact: something the {CHARACTER} dropped earlier is here — it must have arrived before you did
latents.item_desc: Something familiar. You didn't carry it here. You're not sure how it got here first.

latents.fact: the {ANTAGONIST} is not gone — they are waiting in the place you least expect
the final exit looks permanent — but there is a second way out, hidden behind the {THREAT}
